data.street_address: Mall Level -1, Canada Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5AH

description.text:
As a result of a close partnership between the acclaimed Designer Philippe Starck and Photo-Me, we are proud to present the ultimate photobooth solution called “Photo-Me by Starck”. Featuring an aesthetically classic exterior design, the new Photobooth by Starck is equipped with a high resolution 32” LCD external screen using Augmented Reality Technology to captivate and interact with the audience.

For £6 only, the booth produces 1 set of 5 ID photos approved for the UK passport standards requirement. Additionally customers can choose from Portrait photos, 5 different ID poses, Mini-CV photos either in Colour or Black and White for £6 as well.

And finally, new exciting consumer fun products are available for only £2. There is a wide range of fun options using Chromakey technology, from exclusive Pop Art photos to postcards. The new photobooth boasts a tactile control screen and state-of-the-art camera technology that automatically adjusts to users heights, ensuring a perfect picture every time.

Location: Canada Place
